name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.42-beta “Paris” (build 46): Restore Citation Links.
• Submission ▸ Restore Citation Links: citations that lost their links on the way into a document (made from a firm template, stored on SharePoint, run through a clean-up tool) are linked again. Only footnotes that read exactly as LitArbi cites an exhibit are touched, nothing is renumbered, and your own footnotes stay as they are. Update Exhibits from Brief picks them up too.
• Beta testers with an early-adopter offer see it in the licence window, with Upgrade…; the discount is applied on the pricing page.
